$comment: MonkeyLab target manifest (operator-reviewed; Engine consumes only this file at the repo root). The buildTest command runs inside the network-none containment cage via the MonkeyLab toolchain image; node_modules are populated offline from the toolchain image's prepared dependency snapshot.
name: koma

command: if [ ! -f node_modules/.bin/tsx ]; then cp -R /opt/koma/node_modules/. ./node_modules/ && find ./node_modules -mindepth 1 -exec chmod a+rwX {} +; fi
